calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 44 AND 47
ORDER BY fiscal_week

SELECT 
  cp.category,
  AVG(fsw.closing_value) AS avg_stock_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) AS store_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.product_key) AS product_count,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cs.region = 'West'
  AND cs.store_id < 900
  AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2026-03-01', '2026-03-08', '2026-03-15', '2026-03-22')
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category

SELECT 
  cp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cs.region = 'West'
  AND cs.store_id < 900
  AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2026-03-01', '2026-03-08', '2026-03-15', '2026-03-22')
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category
